subject.title: googlechat: deliver media as a text link when attachment upload is unauthorized (app auth)

question: Which open branch should become the sole canonical implementation for the Google Chat app-auth media fallback?
rationale: This PR and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 modify the same three delivery paths and are both conflict-marked; landing parallel implementations would create duplicated policy and drift.

options.title: Refresh the member-authored candidate
options.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 if its narrower upload-error predicate and negative controls remain correct after rebasing onto current main.

options.title: Repair this PR
options.body: Keep this branch as the candidate only after both repeated findings, the proof gap, and its merge conflicts are resolved.

recommendation.title: Refresh the member-authored candidate
recommendation.body: Prefer https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89906 if its narrower upload-error predicate and negative controls remain correct after rebasing onto current main.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history shows broad ownership of the affected Google Chat media and action paths, and the PR timeline records direct awareness of this duplicate cluster.
